observed: Behaviour works, but the footer wording differs from every footer string the scenario expects. Starting state: localStorage 'oldhand-analytics-consent' === null (verified). Step 1/2: on a fresh load of http://localhost:4180/ there was no script[data-oldhand-analytics], no googletagmanager script or resource entry, no position:fixed element (only the sticky HEADER.top), no 'Allow analytics' / 'No thanks' text, no dialog. Footer read 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' with a button 'Turn on Google Analytics' (expected 'Analytics are off.' and 'Turn on anonymous Google Analytics'). Step 3/4: clicked the footer button. localStorage became 'granted'; script[data-oldhand-analytics='true'] appeared in head with src https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-75YW6HE9FT; the page's Resource Timing shows that exact request (script, 364 ms) and gtag.js executed (window.google_tag_manager exists), followed by two www.google-analytics.com/g/collect beacons for G-75YW6HE9FT. Footer then read 'Google Analytics is on.' with button 'Turn it off' (expected 'Anonymous Google Analytics is on.'; the button text matches). Step 5: real reload (navigation type reload): script element present again with no click, consent still 'granted', gtag.js requested again, footer 'Google Analytics is on.' / 'Turn it off'. Step 6: clicked 'Turn it off': localStorage became 'denied'; footer read 'Google Analytics is off; nothing is sent.' with 'Turn on Google Analytics' (expected 'Analytics are off.'). The script element stayed in the DOM for the rest of that page session (consent is switched to denied via gtag; the scenario did not require removal). Extra check: a further reload with 'denied' stored loaded no analytics script and made no googletagmanager/google-analytics request. All wording mismatches are real, not stale: /Users/berwinsingh/Documents/oldhand/site/src/App.jsx lines 359-362 contain the same strings the page rendered.
expected: Before the click: no analytics script, no googletagmanager request, no overlay, footer 'Analytics are off.' with a 'Turn on anonymous Google Analytics' button. After the click: script[data-oldhand-analytics] present, request to www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-75YW6HE9FT, localStorage 'granted', footer 'Anonymous Google Analytics is on.' with a 'Turn it off' button. After reload the script is present without a click. After turning off: localStorage 'denied', footer 'Analytics are off.' again.

I left 'oldhand-analytics-consent' = 'denied' in that browser profile, which another scenario's starting-state check will need to clear.
